units.source_text: 男人顺从地弯腰捡起铁锹。

en.t: The man obediently bent down and picked up the shovel.

units.source_text: 现在这地步，自尊心什么的，就像用熨斗熨烫满是污垢的衬衫似的。

en.t: At this point, pride and the like were as pointless as ironing a shirt covered in grime.

units.source_text: 像被赶出来似的，他跑到了外面。

en.t: As if he had been driven out, he ran outside.
